summary: Afya Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Marcelo Ken Suhara as Chair Member of the Audit, Risks and Ethics Committee, effective July 27, 2026. This follows the death of the previous chair, João Paulo Seibel de Faria, who served as an independent board member and committee chair. Suhara is an existing independent board member and continues as Audit Committee financial expert. No transaction terms, advisors, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a governance transition triggered by an unexpected passing, not a routine notice. Watch for potential additional board or committee adjustments and continuity of audit oversight.
